paite: TOUPA aw, heh in hon sal ke'nla, thangpai in hon sawi sam ke'n.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La: Kaihging Gui Nei A Sak Ding. Sheminith A Sak Ding. / Mangbat Hun A Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, ka gimgawpta a; TOUPA aw, hon damsak in; ka guhte lah ana vekta ngal a;
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

paite: Ka hinna leng nakpitak in hihmangbat in a-om hi; TOUPA aw, nang bang tan ahia na hon etsim ding?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

paite: TOUPA aw, hong kik nawn inla, ka hinna hondam in, na hoihna phatna ziak in hon hondam in.
english: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

paite: Sih nung in nang theihgigena a-om ngal kei a; Sheol ah kua'n ahia na tung a kipahthu gen ding?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

paite: Ka mauna lam ah ka bahta; zan teng in tui ah ka lupna ka kilamsak a; ka lupna ka khitui in ka kawtsak zel hi;
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

paite: Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit ase hulhul a; hon doute ziak in ahong tek deuhdeuhta hi.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

paite: Nou, nna gilou sem tengteng aw, hon paisan vek un; TOUPA'N ka kah ging azata ngal a;
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

paite: TOUPA'N hehpihna ka nget lah angaikheta a; TOUPA'N ka thumna akipahpih ding hi.
english: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

paite: Hon doute tengteng azahlak un amangbang mahmah ding ua; akik nawn ding ua, thakhat in ahong zahlak ding uhi.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
